title: Solomon's Building Projects and the Fleet to Ophir
description: The chapter describes Solomon's extensive building projects, including the Millo, the walls of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and the rebuilt Gezer which Pharaoh had given to his daughter as a dowry. Solomon conscripted the remaining Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites for forced labor, while the Israelites served as warriors and officials. Finally, he built a fleet at Ezion-Geber that brought back 420 talents of gold from Ophir.
